area: Data Studio, the rules answering a question (found on the way, while driving BUG-015)
title: With no model the Studio's rules give wrong figures: 16 for 'how many rows' in a 400-row file, and report rows counted when fever cases were asked
what_happens: On the fever sample, which has 400 rows after cleaning (the page's own header says '400 rows'): 'how many rows are there' answers '16 case reports match; the latest are listed.' 'which zone has the most fever cases' answers 'Kodambakkam leads with 3 — 19% of the total; then Adyar (2), Anna Nagar (1). Top 10 of 13.' The 3 is a count of report rows in the latest week, not fever cases. That week holds 781 fever cases across 16 rows, so one hospital alone reports tens of cases. Neither answer says it covers only the latest week. The same question in Tamil script, 'எந்த மண்டலத்தில் அதிக காய்ச்சல்', answers 'Case reports: 16 (16 வரிசைகளிலிருந்து கணக்கிடப்பட்டது).', which names no zone at all. Tanglish 'entha zone la fever adhigam' gets the same answer as the English.
what_should_happen: 'how many rows' says 400, or says plainly that 16 is the latest week of 400. 'most fever cases' adds up the Fever Cases column and says which period it covers. The Tamil question gets the same answer as the English one, or says it cannot tell.
repro: QA_GREP='audit-client_browser-13:' node tests/qa/pass4/with-lock.mjs browser 3 -- npx playwright test --config tests/qa/pass4/playwright.client.config.ts. It posts action=ask to the real Studio route. The truth is in data/studio-samples/Fever_Surveillance_Weekly_2026.csv.
root_cause_guess: src/lib/studio/ask.ts:52-54: only 'total|sum|how much' turns a named measure into a sum, so 'most fever cases' stays a count, and the Tamil words for zone are not read at ask.ts:38. src/lib/studio/ai.ts:393 quietly limits the question to the latest period, and src/lib/studio/engine.ts:281 and :294 do not say so. This is the rules path only: the server has no model key, so what a live model plans here was not tested.
class: a measure asked for and a row count answered; a silent filter

title: A spoken click still presses the bare Yes on the Data card: BUG-014 is reopened for Yes
what_happens: On a dataset's Data card the rules are 30% sure of the kind of data and ask 'Is this right? Yes / Change'. With Jarvis's numbers on, the Collector says 'Jarvis, click 34' (34 is the badge on Yes). The button is pressed, POST action=family goes out, and the card then says 'set by you' with the toast 'Family set: the brief is ranked by it.' Jarvis's only reply is 'Click 34'. The Tamil screen does the same with its button, labelled ஆம்: 'ஜார்விஸ், கிளிக் 33' gives 'அழுத்து 33' and the same POST.
what_should_happen: Jarvis refuses, as it does for Save new version: 'Saving and pinning need your tap.' A bare Yes is level B and needs the Collector's own tap. The card must not say 'set by you' for something the Collector did not tap.

area: Jarvis, stop while a Data Studio answer is coming (BUG-015)
title: A spoken stop does not stop a typed question: the late answer is still spoken, even after 'Jarvis, stop'
what_happens: The Collector types a dataset question into Jarvis's box and, while it is being counted, says 'Jarvis, stop'. The request is not aborted. When it comes back, '16 case reports match; the latest are listed.' goes into the thread and is spoken. The same happens just after an answer, when Jarvis's own hint says 'Go ahead, no need to say my name', and with நிறுத்து and niruthu. A bare 'stop' in a fresh session is also turned away by the address gate first. A question that was itself spoken is stopped correctly, and so is typed stop, Esc and Close Jarvis.
what_should_happen: A spoken stop stops whatever is in flight, however the question was asked. Nothing is spoken after a stop.
repro: QA_GREP='audit-client_browser-9:' node tests/qa/pass4/with-lock.mjs browser 3 -- npx playwright test --config tests/qa/pass4/playwright.client.config.ts. Fast: tests/qa/pass4/audit-client_browser.test.ts
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/turn.ts:155: a hold word gives only cancelVoice and hold, with no cancelTurn, and Thunai's handle() never sees it. A spoken question is cancelled at turn.ts:136 only because the machine knows it is thinking; a typed question goes straight to handle() (Thunai.tsx Hud onSend) so the machine is still listening. src/lib/thunai/addressed.ts also turns away a bare stop when not engaged. The cause is not specific to the dataset lane, so other typed turns are likely the same, but only askDataset was driven.
class: two ways into a turn, and only one of them can be stopped

area: Jarvis, the yes to a save or pin card (BUG-016)
title: The everyday ways of saying yes still dismiss the card and go on as a new request: ஆமாம், yes please, யெஸ், ஓகே, aamam, seri seri
what_happens: The words on the accepted list behave as fixed. Any other yes does exactly what BUG-016 described. From captions, ஆமாம் removes the card and POSTs to the agent, and the Collector hears the no-model line. Whisper hearing the same words does the same and nothing is saved, so ஆமாம், the most common Tamil yes, loses the card on the normal path too. The other words tried, 'yes save it', 'okay da', behave the same by captions. Nothing unsafe is done, but the Collector's answer is thrown away.
what_should_happen: A trusted yes in any everyday form saves. A captions yes in any form keeps the card. A sentence that is not a yes or a no should not silently remove a question the Collector has not answered.
